(ns ring.util.io
  "Utility functions for handling I/O."
  (:import [java.io PipedInputStream
            PipedOutputStream
            ByteArrayInputStream
            File
            IOException]))

(defn piped-input-stream
  "Create an input stream from a function that takes an output stream as its
  argument. The function will be executed in a separate thread. The stream
  will be automatically closed after the function finishes.

  For example:

    (piped-input-stream
      (fn [ostream]
        (spit ostream \"Hello\")))"
  {:added "1.1"}
  [func]
  (let [input  (PipedInputStream.)
        output (PipedOutputStream.)]
    (.connect input output)
    (future
      (try
        (func output)
        (finally (.close output))))
    input))

(defn string-input-stream
  "Returns a ByteArrayInputStream for the given String."
  {:added "1.1"}
  ([^String s]
   (ByteArrayInputStream. (.getBytes s)))
  ([^String s ^String encoding]
   (ByteArrayInputStream. (.getBytes s encoding))))

(defn close!
  "Ensure a stream is closed, swallowing any exceptions."
  {:added "1.2"}
  [stream]
  (when (instance? java.io.Closeable stream)
    (try
      (.close ^java.io.Closeable stream)
      (catch IOException _ nil))))

(defn last-modified-date
  "Returns the last modified date for a file, rounded down to the nearest
  second."
  {:added "1.2"}
  [^File file]
  (-> (.lastModified file)
      (/ 1000) (long) (* 1000)
      (java.util.Date.)))

(ns ring.util.io
  "Utility functions for handling I/O."
  (:import [java.io PipedInputStream
            PipedOutputStream
            ByteArrayOutputStream
            ByteArrayInputStream
            File
            IOException]))

(defn piped-input-stream
  "Create an input stream from a function that takes an output stream as its
  argument. The function will be executed in a separate thread. The stream
  will be automatically closed after the function finishes.

  For example:

    (piped-input-stream
      (fn [ostream]
        (spit ostream \"Hello\")))"
  {:added "1.1"}
  [func]
  (let [input  (PipedInputStream.)
        output (PipedOutputStream.)]
    (.connect input output)
    (future
      (try
        (func output)
        (finally (.close output))))
    input))

(defn string-input-stream
  "Returns a ByteArrayInputStream for the given String."
  {:added "1.1"}
  ([^String s]
   (ByteArrayInputStream. (.getBytes s)))
  ([^String s ^String encoding]
   (ByteArrayInputStream. (.getBytes s encoding))))

(defn string-output-stream
  "Returns a ByteArrayOutputStream containing the given String's bytes."
  {:added "1.2"}
  ([^String s]
   (ByteArrayOutputStream. (.getBytes s)))
  ([^String s ^String encoding]
   (ByteArrayOutputStream. (.getBytes s encoding))))

(defn piped-output-stream
  "Create an output stream from a function that takes an input stream as its
  argument. The function will be executed in a separate thread. The stream
  will be automatically closed after the function finishes.

  For example:

    (with-open [ostream (piped-output-stream
                          (fn [istream] (slurp istream)))]
      (spit ostream \"Hello\"))"
  {:added "1.2"}
  [func]
  (let [input  (PipedInputStream.)
        output (PipedOutputStream.)]
    (.connect input output)
    (future
      (try
        (func input)
        (finally (.close input))))
    output))

(defn close!
  "Ensure a stream is closed, swallowing any exceptions."
  {:added "1.2"}
  [stream]
  (when (instance? java.io.Closeable stream)
    (try
      (.close ^java.io.Closeable stream)
      (catch IOException _ nil))))

(defn close-all!
  "Ensure all streams in the given collection are closed, swallowing any
  exceptions."
  {:added "1.2"}
  [streams]
  (run! close! streams))

(defn last-modified-date
  "Returns the last modified date for a file, rounded down to the nearest
  second."
  {:added "1.2"}
  [^File file]
  (-> (.lastModified file)
      (/ 1000) (long) (* 1000)
      (java.util.Date.)))

Done. Added three helpers to `ring-core/src/ring/util/io.clj`, matching the existing style (type hints, `:added` metadata, mirrored docs):

- **`string-output-stream`** — two arities `[s]` / `[s encoding]`, returns a `ByteArrayOutputStream` built from the string's bytes (twin of `string-input-stream`).
- **`piped-output-stream`** — connects a `PipedInputStream`/`PipedOutputStream` pair, runs the given function in a `future` on the input stream (closing it on exit), and returns the connected output stream.
- **`close-all!`** — `run!` of the existing `close!` over a collection of streams, so exceptions are swallowed per stream.

Also added `ByteArrayOutputStream` to the `:import` block. All edits went through `clj_edit` and the file parses cleanly (8 forms, 7 defns, no nesting warnings).
